Package aor.proj3t.daos.interfaces

Interface TrainingDAO

All Superinterfaces:
BasicDAO<Training,Long>
All Known Implementing Classes:
TrainingDAOimpl
public interface TrainingDAO extends BasicDAO<Training,Long>
Data Access Object interface for Training entity operations.

This interface extends BasicDAO to provide comprehensive operations for managing training programs within the organization. Training entities represent educational programs, courses, workshops, or skill development activities available to employees.

Key features include:

  • Advanced filtering using TrainingFilter for complex queries
  • Finding available trainings for specific users
  • Training enrollment and participation management
  • Training catalog and discovery functionality

  • Method Details

    • getTrainingsByFilters

      List<Training> getTrainingsByFilters(TrainingFilter filters)
      Retrieves trainings based on complex filtering criteria.

      This method provides advanced querying capabilities using a filter object that can specify multiple criteria such as training area, date ranges, status, location, and other training properties. Essential for implementing search and filtering functionality in training catalogs.

      Parameters:
      filters - The filter criteria to apply. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of trainings matching the filter criteria, or an empty list if no matches are found
      See Also:
      • TrainingFilter

    • findTrainingsNotParticipatedByUser

      List<Training> findTrainingsNotParticipatedByUser(Long userId)
      Finds trainings that a specific user has not yet participated in.

      This method returns available training opportunities for a user by excluding trainings they have already completed or are currently enrolled in. Useful for recommending new training programs and displaying available learning opportunities.

      Parameters:
      userId - The unique identifier of the user. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of trainings not participated by the user, or an empty list if no available trainings exist
